scope: Independent consumed-Dev mechanism replication only. No protected Canary or Official Test access, SOTA claim, or leaderboard claim.
scientific_question: Does one exact Official-path failure payload let the same completed strong-Agent lineage repair more admissible C0 deployment programs than an equal tool-free continuation receiving typed-null feedback?

raw_official_results.note: These raw counts include biothings.api despite its frozen-boundary false positive and model-analysis despite its inadmissible generated-source path. XKNX produced no accepted script and therefore had no Official attempt.

excluded_or_annotated_positions.protocol_deviation: A missing uv timeout signature triggered ineligible exploratory C1/T branches before the exact C0 retry. C1 passed and T failed with seven new imports; neither branch enters primary counts.

excluded_or_annotated_positions.reason: The generic import-artifact audit rejected an exact copy of the checked-in configuration template at a nested runtime path.

classifier_corrections.missing_phrase: Failed to download distribution due to network timeout
classifier_corrections.regression_tests: 17 evaluator-infrastructure tests and 11 subtests plus 6 evaluation-retry tests passed.

cost_observation.interpretation: Success remains primary and token use is not a stopping threshold. The wide spread in C0 trajectory length and environment breadth motivates a later orthogonal efficiency treatment.

decision.trigger: Two independent valid T-exclusive Official repair chains, more T-exclusive than C1-exclusive wins, and no fidelity contradiction in the valid pairs.
decision.consequence: Promote exact Official target-state feedback as one narrow EnvSolve-Pro core step after a strong continuous C0 Agent and unchanged infrastructure retries. Do not promote live frontier, checkpoints, cross-case rules, structured search, or minimization.
decision.statistical_limit: The two valid repairs share one Git ownership family and are not statistically conclusive; no general dependency-solving or leaderboard claim follows.

minimal_algorithm_after_M2: Run one strong Agent in a continuous construction session until it submits a complete deployment program.
Execute that exact program in the real target state used by Official evaluation.
If the observation is infrastructure failure, retry the unchanged program up to the fixed attempt cap and do not update the deployment hypothesis.
If Official passes, stop. If an admissible program has a semantic Official failure, return the exact typed payload once to the same completed Agent lineage.
Execute the single revised complete program in a fresh target environment and report Official success separately from path quality.
required_next_evidence: A larger independent consumed-Dev replication with enough genuine admissible C0 failures to estimate terminal success rather than only progress.
At least one valid non-Git target-state failure where T Official-passes and C1 does not.
A boundary correction for exact tracked-template configuration copies, followed by replay of the affected boundary cases without changing this M2 primary analysis.
Direct comparison against Repo2Run and native Codex under the same Official target and retry policy before any SOTA claim.
